The main analyzer resolves repository-relative paths; strict numerical replay also requires compatible CPU-dispatched kernels.
independent_numeric_cross_check.scope: Independent direct reconstruction of task/aggregate losses, A-prefix scales, and all 18 paired intervals from saved D arrays.

limitations: Passing engineering checks does not imply a distinctive predictive contribution.
No independent refit of every hyperparameter candidate is claimed.
Public checkpoint timing cannot rule out an unrecorded private evaluation; fitting API excludes D targets and the preserved run follows the frozen design.
The three empty-B rideshare tasks remain unavailable; full four-collection aggregates are undefined.
Matching package versions alone does not guarantee bitwise generator replay across CPU dispatch paths; frozen checks and original outcomes remain unchanged.

The selected-state tolerance can also fail across CPU dispatch paths for a saved raw-RBF comparator; the preserved no-refit diagnostic measures roundoff-scale loss changes and does not relabel a failed strict replay as passed.

post_execution_platform_diagnostic.scope: One new Duffing task: native bitwise regeneration succeeds; disabling AVX-512 produces roundoff-scale differences and fails the unchanged exact check. This is a post-execution environment diagnostic, not a replacement scientific audit.

post_execution_selected_state_platform_d.scope: One already selected Wikipedia raw-RBF state: altered NumPy dispatch crosses the unchanged pointwise replay tolerance on C/D, with relative MSE changes below 1e-14. Native replay passes. No predictions or inference results are replaced.
